title: Iterative Topic Taxonomy Induction with LLMs: A Case Study of Electoral Advertising
reasoning: The paper makes the analysis of moral foundations a core component of its methodology and case study. It uses Moral Foundation Theory (MFT) to classify political advertisements into categories such as Care/Harm, Fairness/Cheating, and Loyalty/Betrayal, and evaluates the performance of LLMs in extracting these moral framings.
